status: independent internal audit completed; residual completion and support-to-MW mathematics pass; finite-bit implementation is plausible under the explicit rational construction and failure handling in the audit; external review and priority remain open

claims.statement: Given a rational dense symmetric CPTP broadcaster B:M_d->M_d tensor M_d with equal unital, trace-preserving, HS-selfadjoint marginals Phi, the sampled tree response can be converted, with high probability, into an explicitly listed canonical EB channel with T(N+1) outcomes satisfying I-Psi <= 2 ceil(log2(d^2-1))(I-Phi)+delta I on traceless Hermitian operators, for T=O(log^3(d)/delta^2) and N=O(d delta^-2 log(d T (d^2-1)/eta)).
assumptions: the broadcaster is available as finite exact rational dense data and its CPTP, symmetry, and marginal promises are exact-checkable
the matrix MW and local eigensolver operations are implemented with polynomial precision, and all numerical error is charged to delta
failed exact residual-effect PSD checks are retried or routed to a valid EB fallback and charged to eta
claims.status: internal proof audit passed for the residual POVM completion, covariance estimator, matrix Chernoff/Bernstein application, conditional tree sampler, support-loss accounting, and maximizing MW sign; finite-bit compiler details are specified but not implemented; no external review or priority claim
claims.novelty_boundary: Matrix Bernstein/Chernoff, matrix MW, channel compatibility, and finite de Finetti approximation are established prior art. The internally derived seam is sampling a dual-dependent broadcast-tree outcome, rationally completing its empirical canonical map with an explicit residual POVM outcome, and combining these finite responses into one common EB comparator. Existing many-output de Finetti results require a symmetric extension of the same channel; the depth-m tree here has leaf marginal Phi^m, not Phi. Bounded search only; historical priority is unverified.
costs: A balanced tree has K=2^ceil(log2(d^2-1))<2(d^2-1) leaves.

One exact sampled tree effect costs O(K d^6)=O(d^8) dense arithmetic contractions; total dominant cost is O(T N K d^6)=O(d^9 delta^-4 polylog(d T/eta)) arithmetic operations, with polynomial exact-rational bit growth in K and input length.
The dense broadcaster input has Theta(d^6) coefficients.
The explicit output has D=T(N+1)=poly(d,delta^-1,log eta^-1) effects and states, O(D d^2) listed matrix entries, and can be implemented as a finite POVM plus conditional state preparation.
The compiler uses the broadcaster offline via its dense description; the deployed EB channel does not require broadcaster calls. Device-only inputs require a separate tomography/certification model.
claims.falsifier: A counterexample to the broadcast-tree support score, an incorrect tree outcome law, failure of residual canonical normalization or positivity, concentration failure under the stated bounds, or an invalid maximizing-MW regret inequality would falsify the theorem. A superpolynomial finite-bit obstruction in the exact rational model would falsify the compiler-cost statement.
claims.next_gate: Formalize the end-to-end finite-precision implementation as pseudocode and a bit-operation theorem, then obtain independent mathematical/expert review; retain the unresolved sharp c=2 and dimension-free bounded-Holevo questions.

the full finite-dimensional channel description is available for compilation
